mapper.sql: SELECT J.* ,C.COMPANY_NAME FROM JOB_POSTING J LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON C.COMPANY_ID = J.COMPANY_ID WHERE J.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

select.if: AND (LOWER(J.TITLE) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(C.COMPANY_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%')

choose.when: ORDER BY J.DEADLINE ASC NULLS LAST
